reconnaissance.source_coverage: CC18 and AMLB dataset/task metadata plus original UCI records. No benchmark rankings or scores were used. No FE-paper task names were assumed identical without provenance.
reconnaissance.metadata_collection_limit: This is a bounded completely audited pool, not a claim that all unexamined CC18/AMLB datasets are ineligible.

identity_decisions.hardware_vs_cpu_activity: UCI29 machine specifications predict published PRP. Exposed cpu_act is Sun Sparcstation activity telemetry predicting usr. Different original studies and units of observation; the bare cpu alias is deliberately not registered to the new hardware family.
identity_decisions.gas_turbine: UCI551 explicitly states same plant as exposed UCI294 Combined Cycle Power Plant; rejected as new origin.
identity_decisions.australian_credit: UCI27/143 and OpenML29/40981 are one original collection. Select original OpenML29/task29, preserving missing values; reject the filled/normalized 40981 variant as the primary representation. No additional family count or performance-based choice.
identity_decisions.vertebral: OpenML1523 three-class and1524 binary merge are one patient origin; reserve only original three-class task.
identity_decisions.robot: 24-/4-/2-sensor variants are the same SCITOS G5 sampling steps; one origin only.
identity_decisions.infrared: UCI925 delegates licensing to original PhysioNet v1.0.0. Its two cameras, oral modes and temperature-region variants are one clinical study. Monitor-mode aveOralM selected explicitly; fast-mode aveOralF and SubjectID excluded.

exposure_audit.source_code_identity_search: Read-only Python source search under benchmarks, package, examples and tests found no matching names for the ten selected source origins. Generic names were resolved through explicit UCI/OpenML provenance, not treated as fresh aliases.

ledger.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id

exposure_audit.historical_record_policy: All existing registry records, final/draft/release/audit suites and ledger rows are preserved. This audit records current exposure of the prior twelve without relabeling them fresh or rewriting their historical admission records.
exposure_audit.unknown_exposure_policy: Every new family keeps prior_exposure=unknown. No recorded project model match was found, but metadata review is not a guarantee of unrecorded exposure or public model pretraining absence.
